sous_titre: Part des immatriculations de voitures neuves dans l'Union européenne, en %, 2024 à juin 2026

2024.texte: hybrid-electric cars strengthening their second position, commanding a 30.9% market share

2025.texte: Hybrid-electric car registrations captured 34.5% of the market, remaining the preferred choice among consumers in the EU.

S1 2026.texte: Hybrid-electric models accounted for 37.3% of the total EU market.
